For security vulnerabilities, follow SECURITY.md instead of posting exploit details here.

## Environment

Server version, player version, install method, OS/device model, browser, and LAN/Cloudflare/WireGuard transport. Do not include private hostnames or credentials.

## Reproduction

Steps, expected result, actual result, and frequency.

## Diagnostics

Redacted errors/readiness status and non-sensitive screenshots. Never attach databases, identity files, cookies, tokens, Wi-Fi passwords, or VPN keys.
